concerns.text: FR-003 defines the 'first arrival' date using cumulative counts of complete checklists and then FR-008 adds the same effort covariate (number of complete checklists per cell‑year) as a predictor. Because higher observer effort directly increases the chance of early detections, the effort covariate is not independent of the target definition, creating a circular relationship that can inflate model performance and invalidate inference about temperature/NDVI effects.

FR-010 requires fitting a spatial random‑effects term (e.g., Gaussian Process) within the XGBoost model. The original idea did not request any spatial random‑effects modeling; it only called for a Gradient Boosting Regressor. Adding this component expands the scope beyond the stated research question without a justification of essential methodological rigor.
